C.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers, including common denominators, common denominator conversion, borrowing, normalization of improper mixed numbers, and simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD/LCM/common denominator for unlike fractional parts
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the common denominator before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed
Do not tag for borrowing steps that create an added whole-denominator fraction such as 12/12 or 5/5
Do not tag mere subtraction after common denominators are already established

skills.name: Normalize operand form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or a mixed number with an improper fractional part into a subtraction-ready form without changing its value.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a chosen denominator
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to an equivalent standard mixed number
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary combining of final whole and fraction parts into a mixed number
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part during subtraction
Do not tag equivalent-fraction conversion used only to create a common denominator

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a shared denominator and/or subtract the whole-number parts once the operands are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted
Tag when a step performs both whole-part subtraction and fraction-part subtraction together
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding a common denominator or converting equivalent fractions
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps used because the fractional subtraction would be negative
Do not tag simplification-only steps

skills.name: Borrow across whole
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as a fraction over the current denominator and adjust the whole part to complete subtraction when the fractional part would otherwise be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step borrows 1 from the whole part
Tag when the borrowed 1 is rewritten as denominator/denominator and added to the fractional part
Tag when regrouping resolves a negative fractional difference in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number to a standard mixed number
Do not tag ordinary subtraction steps that do not require regrouping

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or simplify a zero-fraction expression to an integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced by a common factor after subtraction
Tag when a result like 0/3 is simplified to 0
Tag when a mixed-number result includes a fractional part that is explicitly simplified
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag final combination into mixed-number form if no reduction occurs
Do not tag equivalent-fraction conversion done before subtraction
Do not tag subtraction itself

A.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions before subtracting when the original denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtraction.
Tag in mixed-number problems if only the fractional parts need denominator alignment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag for borrowing from a whole number; borrowing changes the mixed-number structure, not the denominator-matching step.
Do not tag for simplifying a final fraction.

skills.name: Normalize nonstandard form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or a mixed number with an improper fractional part into a subtraction-ready form, such as adding a 0-fraction or converting to a standard mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole number plus 0 over a chosen denominator.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to a standard mixed number.
Tag when this rewriting is done to make whole-part and fraction-part subtraction possible.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary separation of already-standard mixed numbers into whole and fractional parts.
Do not tag denominator conversion among proper fractions; that belongs to common-denominator work.
Do not tag borrowing after subtraction has begun.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract the whole and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the forms are aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted directly.
Tag when the subtraction may temporarily produce a negative fractional part before any borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the prior step of finding a common denominator.
Do not tag the borrowing/regrouping step used to fix a negative fractional part.
Do not tag final simplification or recombination alone if no subtraction occurs in that step.

skills.name: Borrow across whole
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as a fraction with the current denominator and adjust the whole part to complete subtraction when the fractional part would otherwise be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 is borrowed from the whole part during mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
Tag when the borrowed whole is rewritten as d/d or added to the existing fractional part.
Tag when borrowing is used after an initial subtraction shows the fractional part is too small.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag simple subtraction cases that do not require regrouping.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as 0/d before subtraction; that is normalization, not borrowing.
Do not tag simplification after borrowing is complete.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms or convert a zero-valued fraction to 0 or an equivalent whole-number result.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0.
Tag when a combined expression like whole plus 0 over d is simplified to a whole number.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag unsimplified final answers that are already in lowest terms.
Do not tag the act of combining whole and fractional parts into a mixed number unless simplification also occurs.
Do not tag denominator conversion before subtraction.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole part and fractional part into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer answer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole-part and fraction-part results are recombined into one answer.
Tag when a result is expressed as a mixed number after subtraction.
Tag when a zero whole part is dropped and only the fractional part is kept.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure fraction subtraction steps that already directly produce the final fraction without a recombination step.
Do not tag simplification alone if no recombination of parts occurs.
Do not tag normalization or borrowing steps.

B.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when the denominators do not already match.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the same denominator before subtracting.
Tag for unlike fractional parts inside mixed-number subtraction as well as for pure fractions.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag steps that only subtract numerators after common denominators are already available.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a mixed number with 0 over a denominator unless equivalent-fraction conversion is also performed.

skills.name: Normalize mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number that has an improper fractional part into a standard mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step changes a form like 2 3/2 into 3 1/2.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized before any subtraction.
Tag whether the normalized number is the minuend or the subtrahend.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary decomposition of a whole number as a mixed number with 0 fractional part.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part during subtraction.
Do not tag simplification of a final answer unless it specifically converts an improper mixed-number part to standard mixed form before subtraction.

skills.name: Rewrite whole as mixed
skills.definition: Express a whole number as a whole plus a zero-valued fractional part so it can be subtracted alongside a fraction or mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a + 0/b.
Tag when this rewrite is used to align whole and fractional parts in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
Tag whether the denominator is chosen from the other term's fraction part.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number.
Do not tag borrowing 1 from the whole part after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag cases where both numbers are already written with explicit whole and fraction parts.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the forms are aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts are subtracted separately in a mixed-number problem.
Tag for direct same-denominator fraction subtraction and for subtraction after denominator matching.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding a common denominator or converting equivalent fractions.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping steps used because the fractional difference is negative.
Do not tag final simplification or recombination alone if no subtraction occurs in that step.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as an equivalent fraction and adjust the whole part when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 is borrowed from the whole part during mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
Tag when the borrowed 1 is rewritten as b/b and added to the fractional part.
Tag when the step resolves a negative fractional difference by regrouping.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as a + 0/b before subtraction.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number.
Do not tag ordinary subtraction steps where no regrouping is needed.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or simplify a zero-valued fraction to an integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction such as 2/10 is reduced to 1/5.
Tag when a result like 0/3 is simplified to 0.
Tag when simplification occurs before or during the final answer statement.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that already produce a fraction in lowest terms without any explicit simplification.
Do not tag recombining whole and fractional parts unless a reduction or zero simplification is performed.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers before subtraction.

skills.name: Combine final form
skills.definition: Assemble the computed whole and fractional parts into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer answer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole-part and fraction-part results are combined into one final number.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted to present a proper fraction result.
Tag when a whole number is stated after combining a whole part with a zero fraction part.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure subtraction steps that do not present the final assembled result.
Do not tag simplification alone unless the step also explicitly combines parts into the final form.
Do not tag denominator matching or borrowing steps.
